# 03a — Cohort descriptors and binary exposure (SHORT)

[Full notebook](../notebooks/03a_baseline.ipynb)

## Objective

Assemble demographic and hospital descriptors with the existing admission-age estimate and binary prescription-order flag.

## Input

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd`
- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_raas`
- MIMIC-IV patient and hospital-admission tables.

## Output and downstream use

- `mimic-iv-portfolio.copd_raas.cohort_copd_baseline`
- Feeds `sql/04_build_outcomes.sql`; this step does not add first-day SOFA.

## Key methods and scope

- Executes `sql/03_build_baseline.sql` and preserves admission age plus raw/topcoded-age fields.
- Adds sex, anchor year/group and continuous hospital LOS; joins binary exposure by patient/admission/stay keys.
- A missing qualifying exposure row is coded 0. This means no qualifying record, not proven non-use.
- Patient `dod` is retained, but hospital `admissions.deathtime` is the later in-hospital endpoint source.
- Prints schema/shape, aggregate age descriptors and exposure counts; does not display patient rows.
- Run `sql/04_build_outcomes.sql` and then `sql/04_build_outcomes_extended.sql` after phase 03 and before any 04-series notebook. Those SQL scripts create the outcome tables; the 04-series notebooks do not. See [the dependency map](METHODS_OVERVIEW.md#outcome-table-dependencies).
